title: Why does haze come at certain times?

segments.text: Why does the haze only come at certain times of the year?
From June to September, the wind blows from the south and the south-west. It carries smoke from fires in Sumatra and Kalimantan across the sea to Singapore.
In October and November, the winds change and heavy rain returns. Rain washes the smoke out of the air, and the north-east monsoon blows it away from us.
So, which way is the wind blowing today? Watch the full episode on TheOneApp, Explored.
